name: IPQualityScore (IP reputation and malicious URL scanner APIs, keyed)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P052 chair rationale: 'IPQS is an established company: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Proprietary fraud score: one vote, never 'malicious' on its own (P052 FC6); VPN/proxy flags are provider claims.

error_markers.reason: IPQualityScore: lookup credits exhausted (success:false 'insufficient credits' in the answer body)
IPQualityScore: request rate exceeded (success:false in the answer body)
IPQualityScore: success:false in an HTTP 200 body (invalid key, invalid input or another provider error)

ipqs.description: IPQualityScore API key (path-embedded; IP and URL reputation only, never e-mail/phone validation)
ipqs.plan_hint: business = a company-owned IPQS key whose plan and terms legal has recorded (P052 FC3, key_plans.ipqs); personal or free accounts stay licence-blocked under the corporate profile

ip.title: IPQualityScore IP reputation (GET /api/json/ip/{key}/{ip}?strictness=0): fraud score, proxy/VPN/Tor flags, recent abuse

terms.quote: veto_lift: a company-owned key with IPQS terms recorded by legal (key-terms, key_plans.ipqs) before it runs under corporate.

ip.notes: Quote: binding council text (P052 FC3). The key travels in the URL path: the central redactor masks the configured key value anywhere in URLs, cache rows, events, logs and evidence (AR01, P052 FC5). Invalid key = HTTP 200 {success:false, message:'Invalid or unauthorized key...'} -> NEEDS_KEY; 'insufficient credits' -> QUOTA; any other success:false -> ERROR; never an absence (FC4). Location fields (city, coordinates, zip) are never kept. The e-mail and phone validation endpoints are never wired (FC1).

url.title: IPQualityScore malicious URL scanner (GET /api/json/url/{key}/{url-encoded}?strictness=0): risk score, phishing/malware/unsafe flags

terms.quote: veto_lift: URL reputation runs only for URLs tagged hostile (malicious/phishing/suspicious), never for internal, confidential or org_profile URLs, and is skipped at TLP:AMBER and above

url.notes: Quote: binding council text (P052 FC2). This source reuses submitted URLs and fetches the target live: the council asked for source-level reuses_queries and fetches_target flags; until the registry supports them (core request) the module enforces the AMBER+ exclusion (SKIPPED 'tlp'), the hostile-tag requirement, the org-profile/internal exclusion and the recipient-token refusal itself.

x_source_flags.basis: P052 FC2/FC6: source-level flags overriding the provider's; recorded here as data until core/providers.py and core/policy.py support them

notes: Owned by batch p3-G02-2 (P052 ipqualityscore). The key 'ipqs' is the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS entry; this fragment adds the alias V3LUM_IPQS_KEY and the plan hint. Monthly budget: the free plan's 1,000 lookups at 80% (P334 block, key scope).
